map_name: Land of Fire and the Shinobi Nations

regions.name: Land of Fire
regions.description: Forest roads, river valleys, and the Hidden Leaf's broad influence.

regions.name: Land of Wind
regions.description: Long dry routes, hidden wells, and the fortified Hidden Sand.

regions.name: Land of Water
regions.description: An island nation of foggy coasts and guarded sea lanes.

regions.name: Land of Waves
regions.description: A small nation across the sea where trade routes and local livelihoods are fragile.

regions.name: Land of Rivers
regions.description: A crossroads of waterways, couriers, and competing border interests.

regions.name: Land of Iron
regions.description: A snowy neutral country whose samurai guard the mountain passes.

encounters.title: A courier off the road
encounters.description: A tired messenger has lost the marked trail and is carrying a sealed village dispatch.

effects.memory: You helped a courier reach the checkpoint safely.

choices.label: Report the dispatch and move on

effects.memory: You reported a lost courier to the nearest patrol.

encounters.title: The patrol's warning
encounters.description: A Leaf patrol warns that a nearby forest path has been disturbed recently.

effects.memory: You followed strange tracks beyond the patrol route.
You relayed the patrol warning to the village.

encounters.title: Trouble at the river bend
encounters.description: A merchant cart is stalled beside a river crossing, its driver watching the tree line.

effects.memory: You helped secure a river crossing for local traders.
You chose a cautious route around a suspicious river bend.

encounters.title: Shelter before the sandstorm
encounters.description: A caravan is racing to reach a stone shelter before the wind erases the road.

effects.memory: You helped a caravan find shelter before the storm.
You waited out a dangerous sandstorm in a roadside shelter.

encounters.title: Tracks beside the caravan road
encounters.description: Fresh footprints cross a supply trail. They may belong to a traveler or someone following the caravan.

effects.memory: You tracked unfamiliar footprints along the caravan road.
You warned passing traders about tracks on the road.

encounters.title: A hidden water cache
encounters.description: A marked cache has been damaged, leaving nearby travelers short on clean water.

effects.memory: You repaired a shared water cache for travelers.
You shared supplies with travelers you met on the road.

encounters.title: A ferry in the fog
encounters.description: A ferry crew has lost sight of the coast and is waiting for someone to find the channel markers.

effects.memory: You helped a ferry find its way through the coastal fog.

choices.label: Wait for the fog to lift

effects.memory: You waited safely for the coastal fog to thin.

encounters.title: A signal beyond the shore
encounters.description: A faint lantern flashes from a rocky inlet after the village watch has ended.

choices.label: Check the inlet with the patrol

effects.memory: You checked a strange coastal signal alongside a patrol.
You reported a strange light beyond the coast.

encounters.title: The missing fisher
encounters.description: A fisher's boat has not returned, and their family is gathering help near the shore.

effects.memory: You joined a search for a missing fisher.
You helped organize supplies for the search party.

encounters.title: The bridge crew needs help
encounters.description: Bridge workers have run short on tools and are struggling to keep the worksite secure.

effects.memory: You helped a bridge crew protect their tools and supplies.

choices.label: Carry word to the nearest town

effects.memory: You carried a message about the bridge crew to town.

encounters.title: A cache under the bridge
encounters.description: A loose stone hides a bundle of goods that does not appear on any local manifest.

effects.memory: You reported an unregistered supply cache to local authorities.
You left a suspicious cache untouched and continued on your way.

encounters.title: The flooded road
encounters.description: Recent rain has cut off a route used by nearby families and supply wagons.

effects.memory: You marked a safe detour around a flooded road.
You sent word for a bridge team to assess the flooded road.

encounters.title: Travelers at the border
encounters.description: Several families have reached a checkpoint after leaving a village affected by a local dispute.

effects.memory: You helped organize aid for families at a border checkpoint.

choices.label: Listen and carry their account onward

effects.memory: You listened to travelers and carried their account to the next settlement.

encounters.title: The broken waystation
encounters.description: A roadside waystation has been damaged, leaving couriers without a safe place to rest.

effects.memory: You helped repair a roadside waystation.
You reported damage to a roadside waystation.

encounters.title: The river checkpoint
encounters.description: A checkpoint is behind schedule and needs help checking travel papers and keeping the crossing orderly.

effects.memory: You helped a river checkpoint keep traffic orderly.
You watched how the checkpoint handled a busy crossing.

encounters.title: Snow closes the pass
encounters.description: A sudden snowfall has trapped supply wagons above a narrow mountain pass.

effects.memory: You helped guide supply wagons down a snowbound pass.
You helped make a temporary shelter near the pass.

encounters.title: A samurai patrol
encounters.description: A samurai patrol asks travelers to explain why they are crossing a neutral mountain route.

choices.label: Answer openly and show your papers

effects.memory: You spoke openly with a samurai patrol at the pass.
You asked a samurai patrol about the condition of the route.

encounters.title: Short supplies at the waystop
encounters.description: A mountain waystop has run low on food before the next scheduled caravan arrives.

effects.memory: You contributed supplies to a mountain waystop.

choices.label: Carry a message to the next town

effects.memory: You carried news of a supply shortage to the next town.
